title: Animal Sound Orchestra | Moo, Roar, Hoot and More for Kids
description:
Eight friendly performers take the Tiny Tales concert stage. Children meet farm, wild, and bird calls—including moo, bleat, oink, cluck, roar, trumpet, hoot, and squawk—then get a clear pause to echo every sound.

A playful listening and speech adventure supporting animal vocabulary, memory, rhythm, and confident participation for children ages 3 to 7.
